## Rules
1. **Legacy Play Button, Hero Pulse Ticker & Zero CSS Pollution:** Homepage play icon must preserve legacy color `#9b9b9b` and `margin-left: -4px`, and hero renders `data-testid="home-market-pulse-ticker"` via `@tanstack/react-query`. Never attach dimensions to generic trigger classes (`.modal-trigger`, `.modal-start`).
2. **Bidirectional Search URL Sync & Trending Skills Bar:** `/search` must synchronize `?key=&page=` bidirectionally with URL state and render one-click trending query pills (`data-testid="search-trending-insights-bar"`) backed by `GET /v1/profile/search/trending/`.

3. **Public Profile Read-Only, Trust & Trajectory Invariants:** `/public/[username]` must never expose editing controls or DnD handles to non-owners, renders `data-testid="profile-trust-score-card"` and `data-testid="career-trajectory-badge"` via `@tanstack/react-query` (`enabled: Boolean(profile)`), and posts abuse reports to `POST /v1/profile/{user_id}/report/`.
4. **Careers, Help, Contact & Blog Conversion Controls:** `/careers` renders `data-testid="careers-openings-list"`, `data-testid="careers-ats-check-link"`, and `data-testid="careers-apply-modal"`. `/help` renders `data-testid="help-faq-filter-bar"` and `data-testid="help-faq-accordion"`. `/contact-us` renders `data-testid="contact-topic-pills"` and `data-testid="contact-form"` posting to `POST /v1/contact/`. `/blog/[slug]` renders `data-testid="blog-career-tools-cta"`.
5. **Candidate Shortlist Bookmarks & Drawer (`/search`, `/public/[username]`, `use-bookmarks.ts`, `saved-shortlist-drawer.tsx`):** Use memoized $O(1)$ `Set<string>` (`bookmarkedSet`) in `useBookmarks()` to prevent $O(C \times B)$ re-renders across `/search` cards, enforce Zero Fake Feedback (`disabled={isPending}` pulse until HTTP `200/201/204`), and render `data-testid="open-shortlist-drawer-btn"`, `data-testid="public-profile-bookmark-btn"`, `data-testid="saved-shortlist-drawer"`, and `data-testid="shortlist-empty-state"` (`375px` responsive slide-over).

## Known Traps
- **Hidden Profile Timeline & Trust Leak (C-01):** Do not fetch timeline lists or trust scores on public views until the main profile query resolves (`enabled: Boolean(profile)`).
- **Contact Endpoint:** Public contact forms post to `POST /v1/contact/`.
